thread:
sarah.m: Quick Q — we're switching to the new promotion evidence templates this cycle. Where do managers attach reviewer PRs and the final sign-off docs? Need to lock timelines so payroll cutover doesn't miss anyone.

alex: short answer: upload to the shared People Ops Google Drive folder and paste the link into the Workday case.

maria_p: adding detail — the canonical location is the People Ops drive > Promotions > 2026 Q1 > evidence. We also have a Confluence template id PROM-EVID-2026 that managers should use.

jon: do we still need the two-manager reviewer signoff for L4->L5? the new template made that checkbox optional.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: policy v2.1 requires two independent manager reviewers for role changes that include base salary increases > 7%. See policy doc: https://redwoodintra/confluence/promotions/policy-v2.1

maria_p: jon — good catch. The template allows a single reviewer for title-only moves, but for comp changes the checklist requires the second reviewer + compensation partner approval.

sarah.m: got it. For the practical flow, can we put together a tiny escalation map? e.g., if manager misses evidence upload 48h before cutover -> auto-reminder -> people-ops escalation -> payroll hold?

alex: proposed flow: 1) 48h before cutover automated Slack reminder to manager & manager's director. 2) 24h before cutover, people-ops reviewer pings manager in thread and opens a Workday case. 3) 4h before cutover, if still missing, payroll holds the change and notifies manager + HRBP.

maria_p: agree. Also add: if manager disputes hold, they must submit an "escalation packet" (evidence + manager note + director ack) and file to people-ops@redwood.com within 24h to be considered for an exception.

jon: can we get the automated reminders wired to Slack and email? some managers ignore Slack threads.

people-ops-bot: Action item created: /task create "Wire promotion reminders to Slack + email" assigned to alex, due 2026-02-20.

alex: I'll own wiring both channels. For email we'll use the promo-notify list and include payroll & HRBP.

sarah.m: sample checklist snippet for clarity (paste below) — can we put this into the Confluence template too?

alex: please paste the snippet here and i'll sync to Confluence.

maria_p: ```
- Candidate name
- Role/title (from org chart)
- Effective date
- Compensation change details (amount, pct)
- Evidence attachments: manager justification, peer feedback excerpts, performance artifacts (link to docs)
- Reviewer 1 name / sign-off
- Reviewer 2 name / sign-off (required if comp change > 7%)
- Director ack
- HRBP review (comp partner comment)
- Final People Ops intake (date/time)
```

jon: looks comprehensive. One small ask — include a short field for "known risk/regression" (e.g., backfill, market comp variance) so payroll knows to flag comp bands.

maria_p: added.

alex: next steps: i'll implement reminders and update the Confluence template with the checklist + link to Drive. people-ops, i'll need the list of payroll cutover windows for 2026.

sarah.m: cc @people-ops-bot — can you attach the cutover windows doc to the action?

people-ops-bot: Done — attached: https://redwoodintra/drive/promotions/cutover-windows-2026.xlsx.

jon: timeline question — if a manager submits with incomplete evidence 12h before cutover, do we auto-hold or allow a one-time reviewer grace?

maria_p: default is hold at 4h. But managers can request a one-time expedited review if they provide a full escalation packet and director ack; people-ops will triage and notify payroll. Keep requests rare.

sarah.m: perfect. can someone summarize this into a 2-paragraph note i can send to managers? i want it short and prescriptive.

alex: i'll draft the note and drop it in #people-ops-docs by EOD. Will ping for sign-off. :thumbsup:

maria_p: thanks — also tagging @jon to make sure we capture the L4->L5 reviewer rule change in the template before we publish.

jon: will do.

sarah.m: thanks team. closing the thread once alex posts the manager note. :rocket:
